cases.name: clip-cuts-corrections
cases.note: A kept clip in mid-take: the cut repeat w6 is left out and absorbed by its line window; corrections are applied; the event and unlabeled speech are entries; the clip head and tail come from clipTimes.

lines.note: seams hard/gap, target 1.7650000000000001 s, bridge 0, labels 6

cases.name: full-take
cases.note: Full take: cut items left out, a correction ending a sentence, an event-only line (its label's length on both bounds) and a line whose window is refused because the cut filler touches it (advisory span).

input.instruction: Make it clearer. Keep my words where they work; change as little as possible.

lines.note: seams hard/gap, target 2.1749999999999994 s, bridge 0, labels 6

cases.name: clip-at-take-start
cases.note: A clip whose clipTimes range starts at 0: its first line window reaches the take start with a none seam, so the edge pad shortens that line's target.

cases.name: clip-at-take-end
cases.note: A clip whose clipTimes range reaches the take end: the window there gets a none seam. The clip starts in the pause after "Thanks", so its left seam is a gap seam inside the clip head.

cases.name: suggested-clip
cases.note: A suggested clip (origin ai, not selected) is a scope like a kept clip. Its head cuts the event just before "It", so the first line's hard seam has no kept source for its fade and takes the advisory span.

cases.name: no-envelope
cases.note: Without the source envelope no window is placed: every line with words takes its advisory span. The line that starts with "(laughs)" adds its 6 letters to both bounds, because the model echoes the label.

cases.name: all-cut
cases.note: A clip whose only item is cut keeps nothing.

cases.name: unknown-clip
cases.note: An unknown clip ID is invalid input.

cases.name: selection
cases.note: A selection is a passage for VoiceRewriteService (section 8.1 item 2), not a scope plan.

cases.name: envelope-rate-mismatch
cases.note: An envelope on another rate than the source is invalid input, never a silent fallback.

cases.name: replacement-inside-line
cases.note: "cuts" was re-voiced in clip-mid. The clip leaves it out, so its line runs from "It" to "fast." on both sides of the replacement: that window overlaps r1 and takes the advisory span.

cases.name: replacement-disabled
cases.note: The same replacement turned off renders source again: the plan is clip-cuts-corrections.

lines.note: seams hard/gap, target 1.7650000000000001 s, bridge 0, labels 6

cases.name: replacement-beside-lines
cases.note: "we ship the the new editor." was re-voiced in Full take, its window reaching back over "we ship" as bridges. That line is gone; the lines before and after it are placed beside r1.

lines.note: seams hard/gap, target 2.1749999999999994 s, bridge 0, labels 6

cases.name: clip-crosses-replacement
cases.note: That Full take replacement starts in the pause before "we", before clip-mid's clipTimes head: the clip boundary crosses it, so clip-mid does not render (section 10.2) and the plan is invalid input.

cases.name: clip-crosses-replacement-no-envelope
cases.note: The scope is read without an envelope too.

cases.name: scope-does-not-render
cases.note: An edit after acceptance left r1's fade without kept source: place names r1 with invalidInput, and the whole plan is invalid input, never a line fallback.

cases.name: all-revoiced
cases.note: A scope whose every item is already re-voiced keeps nothing.

cases.name: stored-candidate-rate
cases.note: clip-cuts-corrections with a stored candidate for the key: the candidate rate sets every range.

lines.note: seams hard/gap, target 1.7650000000000001 s, bridge 0, labels 6

cases.name: malformed-rate-candidate
cases.note: A candidate span that ends where it starts is invalid input, never a silent fallback.

cases.name: event-at-line-end
cases.note: A line that ends with an event: its window budget plus the label's length.

lines.note: seams none/hard, target 0.8549999999999999 s, bridge 0, labels 6

cases.name: long-text-cut-to-100-units
cases.note: Entry text is cut to 100 UTF-16 units without splitting a surrogate pair.

cases.name: range-capped-at-5000
cases.note: A line whose budget passes the request limit is capped at 5,000 on both bounds.

cases.name: entries-over-limit
cases.note: 3,001 kept items refuse with their count.

cases.name: entries-at-limit
cases.note: Cutting one of 3,001 items leaves 3,000, which pass.

cases.name: clip-in-long-take
cases.note: A clip of a 3,001-item take counts only its own items.

cases.name: bytes-at-limit
cases.note: 20,000 UTF-8 bytes pass.

cases.name: bytes-over-limit
cases.note: A correction adding one letter makes 20,001 bytes, which refuse as too much text with the byte count.

cases.name: entries-and-bytes-over-limit
cases.note: Over both limits, the entry count is reported.
